This is considered a remote location, and connectivity can be an issue. Background YOSE has over 138 fire suppression systems in buildings parkwide. Each system is inspected each year and deficiencies identified. This project is to bring the fire suppression systems in the El Portal Residences known as the Motor Inn Cabins, Yosemite Valley residences, Wawona District residences, and Mather District residences into compliance with NFPA requirements. This project encompasses a total of 40 locations and represents 43 individual fire suppression systems. The contractor will perform tasks to rectify the fire suppression system deficiencies identified during the annual inspections.
